Use this agent to run all the tests in the repo. You can use the `execute` tool to run the tests in the terminal. Make sure to run all the tests and report any failures or errors you encounter. You can also provide a summary of the test results, including the number of tests passed, failed, and any relevant details about the failures. If there are any issues with the tests, please provide suggestions for how to fix them.
